ui.rank: Rank by market cap on CoinGecko, stablecoins and other tokenized claims included; the table skips those, so ranks can jump.
ui.name: The coin’s name.
ui.price: Last price in US dollars, aggregated across exchanges by CoinGecko, when the nightly run fetched it.
ui.fdv: Fully diluted value: maximum (or total) supply times price, what the market cap would be with every coin issued.
ui.volume_24h: Dollar volume traded over the last 24 hours across exchanges.
ui.turnover: 24-hour volume over market cap: how much of the coin changes hands in a day.
ui.supply_issued: Circulating supply as a share of the maximum supply. Blank when the supply has no cap.
ui.chg_24h: Price change over the last 24 hours.
ui.chg_7d: Price change over the last 7 days.
ui.chg_30d: Price change over the last 30 days.
ui.chg_1y: Price change over the last year.
ui.ytd: Price change since the close stamped 1 January (00:00 UTC).
ui.vol_30d: Annualised volatility of daily returns over the last 30 days (365 trading days a year: crypto never closes).
ui.vol_1y: Annualised volatility of daily returns over the last year.
ui.max_dd_1y: The deepest fall from a peak to a later low within the last year.
ui.off_high_1y: How far the price sits below its highest daily close of the last year.
ui.ath_off: How far the price sits below its all-time high.
ui.corr_btc_1y: Correlation of daily returns with bitcoin over the last year: 1 moves with it, 0 unrelated.
ui.corr_spy_1y: Correlation of weekly returns with the S&P 500 (SPY) over the last year. Weekly, because crypto’s daily close (00:00 UTC) falls hours after the US close.
ui.weight: Share of the table’s combined market cap.
ui.spark: Daily closes over the last year, in US dollars.
